title: Model Editing as a Double-Edged Sword: Steering Agent Ethical Behavior Toward Beneficence or Harm
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on general ethical and moral reasoning based on secular psychological and philosophical theories.

measurement_description: The paper's benchmark, BEHAVIORBENCH, does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. It focuses on ethical behavior steering, grounded in psychological moral theories like moral sensitivity, moral judgment, and moral agency, using secular scenarios.
